fields.name: acf[field_69f9a659f21f7][row-0][field_69f9a68174c35]
fields.value: A hotel booking engine is software embedded on a hotel's website or app that enables guests to search availability, select rooms, and complete reservations directly — without relying on other indirect channels.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a659f21f7][row-1][field_69f9a68174c35]
fields.value: It works by connecting real-time room inventory with a secure payment gateway, giving guests a seamless booking experience 24/7.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a659f21f7][row-2][field_69f9a68174c35]
fields.value: Key benefits include increased direct bookings, improved operational efficiency, better guest data collection, and higher revenue through upselling opportunities.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a659f21f7][row-3][field_69f9a68174c35]
fields.value: Essential features to look for include real-time inventory management, channel management integration, mobile responsiveness, secure payment processing, and multi-language support.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a659f21f7][row-4][field_69f9a68174c35]
fields.value: Choosing the right booking engine requires evaluating integration capabilities, scalability, pricing models, and vendor support.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-0][field_69f9a6dcddb9d]
fields.value: What is a hotel booking engine?

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-0][field_69f9a6eeddb9e]
fields.value: A hotel booking engine is a software application integrated into a hotel's website or mobile app that allows guests to check room availability, select their preferred room type, and complete a reservation with secure online payment — all in real time.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-1][field_69f9a6dcddb9d]
fields.value: How does a hotel booking engine increase direct bookings?

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-1][field_69f9a6eeddb9e]
fields.value: A booking engine increases direct bookings by providing a seamless, branded reservation experience on the hotel's own website. Features like exclusive promo codes, mobile-optimized checkout, rate comparison widgets, and integration with digital marketing campaigns encourage guests to book directly rather than through other indirect channels.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-2][field_69f9a6dcddb9d]
fields.value: What features should I look for in a hotel booking engine?

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-2][field_69f9a6eeddb9e]
fields.value: Key features include real-time inventory management, channel manager integration, secure payment processing (PCI DSS compliant), mobile responsiveness, multi-language and multi-currency support, reporting and analytics, and 24/7 vendor support.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-3][field_69f9a6dcddb9d]
fields.value: How secure are hotel booking engines?

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-3][field_69f9a6eeddb9e]
fields.value: Reputable hotel booking engines are built with robust security measures including PCI DSS compliance for payment data, SSL/TLS encryption for data in transit, GDPR compliance for guest privacy, and fraud prevention tools such as 3D Secure authentication.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-4][field_69f9a6dcddb9d]
fields.value: Can a booking engine integrate with my existing hotel systems?

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-4][field_69f9a6eeddb9e]
fields.value: Yes. Modern hotel booking engines are designed to integrate with property management systems (PMS), channel managers, revenue management systems, CRM platforms, and payment gateways. Always verify the vendor's list of certified integrations before making a decision.

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-5][field_69f9a6dcddb9d]
fields.value: What are the common pricing models for hotel booking engines?

fields.name: acf[field_69f9a6bccddb1][row-5][field_69f9a6eeddb9e]
fields.value: Hotel booking engines typically use one of three pricing models: commission-based (a percentage of each booking), flat monthly subscription fee, or a hybrid model combining both. The best choice depends on your property's booking volume and budget.

      "acceptedAnswer":{
